title: エリザベス女王杯の後に・Win!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Gooo! Run, Fine Motion!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Rrraaagh! I'm coming for you, Fine!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: (No, stay away. I won't let you have it… I won't let you take my victory…)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I absolutely will not lose! HAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The hell? What's with that face?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That yell? That passion? I thought she kept those hidden away…

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Wait, are things changing? Can she actually change things? There's no way…

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Could she be the one to tear everything down?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Pft… What am I, stupid? She'll be gone soon.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That's right. Everything will go according to my data. However, if there's even a millimeter of wiggle room…

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Whoooa! That was intense!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: What an incredible run by Fine Motion! Kawakami was amazing too!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I looost! Waaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Did I… beat you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Why else would I be crying?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …! Wow!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: This is the first time I've seen you so pumped up, Fine!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah! Well, I…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You were completely into it, right?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I get it. I'm super bummed about losing, but it was a lot of fun too!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …Yes. Thank you, Kawakami.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Just now, I…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I forgot for a moment that I was "Fine Motion" the lady.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion was able to defeat her challenger, Kawakami Princess. However…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes… Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Well…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I think I finally understand what makes racing fun.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I reckon it's because everyone competes with a genuine desire to win.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Kawakami cried after she lost. That proves how much our race must have meant to her.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And when I realized that I wanted to win, it became twice as fun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: These are likely her true feelings, but I get the sense it isn't what she wants to talk about right now. I'm about to ask her, when…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Let's decide on a race for next year, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I need to keep running, and… I want to choose another smashing race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her ability, she should be more than capable of running more high-level G1 races. That doesn't mean it will be easy, however.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're okay to keep racing like we have been?
Are you sure you're okay to keep racing like we have been?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm asking to make sure she still has the resolve to be a racer.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Of course! Please, go on.
choice_data_list: What do you think about the Osaka Hai?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Osaka Hai is a G1 race that decides the best medium-distance runner of the spring. I'd like to put both Fine Motion's skills to the test with this rather intense bout.
choice_data_list: I'm sure you'll find many challenging rivals.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …Yes. I certainly hope so.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, our next objective is the Osaka Hai—the first battle for the Senior Spring Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We return to the waiting room to find an unexpected visitor waiting for us.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: So you did come to watch me race? I knew you woul—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Should you really be so laid-back right now? You only have one year left, you know.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You understand what that means, right? All the joys you've managed to find will all vanish.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Not a single one will remain—all you'll have is those memories you love so much.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Spare me the lecture, thanks. I'm only stating facts.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I told you before, didn't I? This is where she peaks. My data shows that things will peter out quietly.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: If you don't like it, all you can do is fight. You get that, Fine?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't know Air Shakur very well, but she's not the kind to hurt someone for the fun of it. She must have some kind of objective…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Shakur sure likes playing the villain.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: She's always like that, so please don't let it bother you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Besides, we've got the Osaka Hai as our next objective! Now, let's go get some Kyoto ramen! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion is acting the same as ever. Her smile is perfectly bright… but she seems vaguely uneasy.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I absolutely will not lose! HAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'd have been better off never finding those joys to begin with. I mean…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: They're all just going to disappear anyway.
